What this tower covers

Quantum & Advanced Compute is the frontier tower, run with a pragmatist's discipline. We deliver quantum readiness assessments, harvest-now-decrypt-later risk analysis, post-quantum cryptography migration programs, quantum and quantum-inspired optimization for routing, scheduling, portfolio and formulation problems, quantum machine learning pilots, and HPC engineering for simulation-heavy industries. Every roadmap separates near-term ROI from long-horizon positioning.

Why this tower, why now

Two clocks are ticking: NIST's post-quantum standards (ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA) have started a multi-year migration clock for every enterprise holding long-lived secrets, while quantum and quantum-inspired optimization already delivers measurable wins in logistics, energy and finance. Leaders sequence both; laggards face a compressed, expensive scramble.
